buxton_h2_0.text: Buxton claims to be the highest market town in England, about a thousand feet up. We get snow when London gets drizzle.
Poole's Cavern is just up the hill. Legend says an outlaw called Poole hid in it. Sensible man, it is dry in there.

then.text: Back for the Bakewell Pudding? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: A pudding, mind. Not a tart. Folk round here get quite sharp about it.
Jam on the bottom, egg and almond on top, and it all goes in together. Legend says it was a mistake by a cook in Bakewell. Best mistake in Derbyshire.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
